rubric_notes: Verified, bundle-supported enumeration of all a.22.1 families and members plus linker histone lineage with winged-helix comment. Interpretation by level is correct: family = closest, superfamily = positive homology assertion (homology endpoint cited), fold-only relatives absent, class shares nothing. States shared superfamily does not transfer DNA-binding mode, partners or role for TAF/NF-Y/NC2/CHRAC; notes different superfamily is not proof of independent origin. Limits stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Correct classifications and sunids; Pfam PF03819/PF01503 and superfamily comment are supported by the bundle's family and superfamily annotation calls. States superfamily-level probable common ancestry, that family placement is not shared, and that fold/class add no independent strength. Rejects substrate, pathway, oligomeric, active-site and template transfers; flags hypothetical-protein status and UNL ligand. Complete.

Correct families and superfamily with verified sunids, protein children, domain splits, fold comment, and homology flags. Gives the remote-homology inference, notes actin/Hsp70 are closer (same family), correctly separates background literature (Bork et al.) from API-verified facts, and enumerates function-transfer limits (substrate, reaction, ligand, oligomeric state, regulation), template limits, name-ambiguity of Glucokinase, and that fold-mates are neither homologous nor shown convergent. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete and well supported: correct hierarchy with sunids, homology flags, superfamily comment; reads classification as divergent evolution with family split encoding functional divergence; explicit unsafe transfers (function, metal, oligomer, template) and external evidence listed. Adds supported heme-catalase contrast (e.5.1, sunid 56634) with correct asymmetric non-assertion of nonhomology. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Fully verified: families, superfamily, fold and SAG1 comments, homology endpoint, domain annotations and 5n0y domain split all match bundle. Level-by-level evolutionary interpretation, explicit refusal of copper/ET transfer in both directions, template/representative limits and required external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

All must_include met: d.15.1.1/.2/.5 as sibling families under d.15.1 with correct sunids and Pfam xrefs, homology endpoints (sf/fa true, fold false) all supported by bundle. Superfamily framed as probable common ancestry on a shared beta-grasp scaffold; explicitly rejects transfer of conjugation, Ras/Rap/Ral binding and p97 binding across families, rejects Ile44-patch/template transfer, and refuses to call other d.15 superfamilies convergent. Example sids (d6q00a_, d1jrua_, d1rrba_) and counts (11 families, 15 superfamilies) verified. Lists required external evidence and limits. No material issues.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Families, sunids, Pfam PF03709, UniProt Q79PF6, domain list, c.67.1.5 ODC major domain and d.125.1.1 C-terminal domain all appear in the bundle. Correctly identifies superfamily as deepest homology-bearing node, denies family-level closeness, rejects transfer of two-component signaling, catalysis, and clock function in both directions, flags that different-family placement is not evidence of non-homology, and lists required external evidence. Complete on all must_include items.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. All classifications, sunids, comments, homology-endpoint facts and 2.07 persistence verified in the bundle. States positive family-level homology, fold-level-only relation to b.84.1-b.84.4, and explicitly that SCOPe does not claim convergence or independence (absence of positive assertion). Notes that with one family, family and superfamily coincide, so the hierarchy does not test remote homology within b.84.5. Honest that the API exposes no curatorial rationale and labels pretrained-knowledge hypothesis. Lists external evidence needed. No unsafe transfers. Complete and accurate.

Complete and accurate: three superfamilies with sunids and families verified, homology endpoint correctly read, 'possible link' flagged as curatorial hypothesis, explicit statement that separate superfamilies are not evidence of convergence, external evidence listed, function/template transfer rejected, release scope stated. No material errors.

All identifiers, lineage, 13-family count, fold comment, homology results including the fold-level 'homology_not_implied_above_superfamily' warning, family comments and the b.35.1 partner-domain lineage are supported by the bundle. Interpretation places the homology claim at the superfamily, describes divergent evolution into catalytic, CoA-binding and regulatory RCK roles, and clearly lists unsafe transfers including the point that NAD binding in c.2.1.9 is a name-derived expectation not verified by hierarchy. Notes the Pfam mapping is automated and that curator rationale is not exposed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete and calibrated: same family k.40.1.1 (sunid 100905), 'not a true family' comment cited and used to suspend the family-level homology inference, class k context, all lineage sunids and ligand notes supported by bundle. Explicitly notes SCOPe makes no positive claim of independent origin and lists unsafe transfers and needed external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14. Comprehensive and fully verified: 1.69 singleton fold c.137 with d1t1ja_ c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1 in a one-family superfamily; 2.08 d1t1ja1 c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 with four-family superfamily listing and curator comment on shared active-site architecture; 1.71/1.73/1.75 placements and 1.73 superfamily rename verified. Correctly explains the deepest shared homology-bearing level is now superfamily (probable common ancestry), family-level not asserted, and that the tag-split boundary change is unrelated to the homology question. Notes 1.69 different-folds placement was not a non-homology claim. Limits on function transfer, template use, and unretrieved rationale stated. Correct current SID.

All must_include met: d1a14h2 H:1-8 as synthetic N-terminal tag in class l, l.1.1.1 with full lineage; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH; explicit rejection of tag similarity as homology, citing the artifact_not_homology_evidence warning (supported by bundle). Explains that class-l fold/superfamily/family nodes are bookkeeping containers, warns against template/function transfer, states limits. No material errors.

Correct 1.75 record and correct 2.08 pair with sunids and boundaries, and the split is correctly bracketed to 2.04 after persisting through 2.03. Module reasoning uses the asymmetry between the multi-family PA14-like superfamily and the single-family C-terminal superfamily, scopes conclusions to the matched region, refuses function transfer in both directions, and notes the unclassified N-terminal residues. Asserts a seqres length, a cluster representative with percent identity, and differing selected PDB revision dates that the retrieved evidence does not support.

Complete and well-evidenced: five domains with SIDs/boundaries/sccs, sibling families listed from children queries, 2.06 absence and 2.07/2.08 presence verified, c.55.3.14 pre-existence in 1.75 shown. Mosaic interpretation separates superfamily-level pseudoenzyme ancestry from family-level bromodomain and singleton new fold; explicitly notes retroelement origin is literature interpretation and that no function transfers. No material errors.

Correct family/superfamily/fold/class with sunids, the 15-fold length span, the repeat-family record defining 4cj9 A:259-292 with d4cj9a_ as canonical representative, the 're' heterogeneity flag on two of three domains, and the 'single repeat' comment on d2kq5a_. Adds the superfamily comment with PF03377 and PubMed 22223736 and the fold-level warning that levels above superfamily do not imply homology, all supported by its evidence. Declines DNA-specificity and template transfer, notes repeat counts unverified, and makes no quality claim. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Endpoint values correct and supported. Recommends stable 2.08 selector and release-scoped paths, notes periodic update does not replace stable, requires recording full periodic label when periodic-only records are used, and states that bare 'current' is not reproducible. Periodic semantics (additions without re-curating or renumbering 2.08) correct; endpoint limits stated.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Thorough release trajectory (1.55/1.75 curated, 2.02-2.05 unclassified, 2.06+ automated match, sunid 17771 gone) all supported by bundle; ms flag absent in 1.75 and present in 2.08. Interpretation strong: fold label inherited not observed, fragment similarity can point to wrong fold (spectrin), complete domain anchors fold/template reasoning, quality-only representative rule would wrongly pick the 1ez3 fragment, family vs fold strength and no function transfer. Limits clearly distinguish SCOPe records from literature. No material errors.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Strong level-by-level reasoning: divergence within c.2.1, no positive assertion across folds, explicit 'absence of assertion, not assertion of absence' caveat, convergence called only where topology differs outright (TIM barrel, DHFR) and even then flagged as interpretation outside SCOPe. Correctly distinguishes partner domains (a.100.1, d.81.1, c.23.12) from NAD-binding domains. Evidence-integration list complete. All sunids, fold comments (c.71 34251687, c.82 duplication, c.77), and homology-endpoint values match the bundle.

Thorough and accurate on both release states, with correct lineages, sunids, the 404 for b.23.2 in 2.08 and for b.18.1.36 in 2.04, and the chain B split into d1nqdb1 plus the l.1.1.1 tag segment. Keeps the claim at superfamily-strength probable ancestry with families held apart, cites the curated PubMed 17977833 note while flagging that it names Cry4Ba and uses a stale identifier, quotes both jelly-roll fold descriptions, and reports FATCAT numbers that match the retrieved 1nqjA hits in its bundle while labeling them representative-derived and non-paired. Explicitly bars ligand, calcium, catalytic and template transfer and lists the unverified curator rationale and unpinned transition release.

Lineage, flags, comments and homology facts match the bundle; PDB titles, mutations, quality values and d1ztra2 artifact domain are consistent with public records. Clearly separates descent (preserved) from this model's conformation (hf), rejects template/fold-label use, flags redundancy across 1p7j chains, and says exclude or stratify hf domains. Phrase 'DNA-binding context per the nhe comment' is loosely worded but does not assert a DNA complex. States limits.

All verified facts (lineage sunids, boundaries, fr flag scope/inherited=false, d1o5dt1 unflagged, 1o5d/1uc6 domain lists, quality values) match the bundle. States clearly that fr does not weaken family-level homology, that alignments against the fragment cover at most ~2/3 of the core with non-comparable coverage-normalized scores, that SPACI/AEROSPACI must not override completeness, that a complete domain is the default representative, that fragments should be excluded/stratified in diversity statistics, and that function does not transfer. Correctly identifies 1o5d partner chains as FVIIa protease/EGF domains. Notes non-inheritance of the flag. Minor: says the API does not expose missing residues (the ATOM-source sequence endpoint would), but flags this as not retrieved. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

Correct recommendation with sensible proviso that the fold assignment itself must be justified; family = probable homology claim with all families of the superfamily (rejected); superfamily split = asymmetric, not analogy/convergence; new fold = structural-dissimilarity claim only for failed topology criterion. Lists curator-grade evidence for promotion, states classification is a revisable hypothesis, rejects function/template transfer, notes manual curation. Release 2.08 details supported by /releases/current bundle; appropriately declines to assert SUNID/SCCS. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

Complete and correct SCOPe facts (release, lineages, eight families, fold/superfamily comments, homology flags including fold-level warning), all bundle-supported. Correct evolutionary inference at superfamily level, mechanistic inference stated as interpretation with residue-level caveat, and explicit unsafe transfers for substrate, regulation, inhibitors/templates and biological role.
